exclude: left from the boot: the text screen ($0400-$07E7) and BOOT, the BASIC program at $0801 that started the loader, with its variables; colours_to_ram stages colours at $0C00-$0FFF
the $4000 display buffer: the bitmap, the screen matrix at $6000 and the colours at $6400, filled by unpack_picture and draw_shape
the $C000 display buffer: the bitmap (under the I/O from $D000), the screen matrix at $E000 and the colours at $E400; BOOT's 40-byte loader at $C000 is drawn over

RAM under the KERNAL written before the title runs: $FD02 holds $08 (what wrote it is not traced) and $FD30-$FD4F a copy of the KERNAL's default vectors (IRQ $EA31, BRK $FE66, NMI $FE47 and the I/O routines); the title never reads them
